variant: D Console with rotating signal beacon
units: 8 arbitrary horizontal units = 4 cells, not meters
axes: X right, Y rear, Z up; front -Y
modelingState: all emission OFF, dark gray beacon cover, gate CLOSED, carriage at rest

beacon.motion: internal reflector rotates around vertical axis; pedestal and protective cover remain fixed
beacon.activeLight: amber rotating sweep; separate emissive mask/material or light effect, no bright pattern baked in albedo
beacon.production: rotate and emit while actual queue progress advances
beacon.research: same active-work indication for shared research queue
beacon.complete: stop and switch off; no delay to gameplay
beacon.timing: speed, sweep width, intensity and fade unapproved; preview schematic only

carriage.group: orange housing and attached graphite center move together
carriage.motion: short horizontal service loop retained from D concept, secondary to beacon; never crosses flight deck
carriage.cancelled: end cycle and return to park
carriage.clearance: end-stop range validated on coarse rail, refine detailed clamps and bearings

queue: One shared aircraft-production/research queue; no independent simultaneous jobs
launch: separate future event, no rule requiring landing or docking, no delay introduced
limitations: coarse shared proportion guide; hidden shell details proposed; final mesh UV materials rig and Unity effect not created
